title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
slides: Vercel's fastest AI model ever? Jev, but why now?
Jev launched with over 1 million weekly users
Yet 90% of its code runs on hidden fallback models
Your latency drops only if you enable Jev's cache layer
Test Jev on one endpoint before your users do
thread_text:
1. 1M users, 90% fallback

Jev hit 1M weekly users but 90% of its code runs on hidden fallback models—so those speed claims are mostly the old model behind a new label.

2. Speed only with cache

Your latency drops only if you enable Jev's cache layer. Without it, you're not seeing the benchmark numbers—you're seeing network reality.

3. Why launch now?

Vercel needed this announcement before developers start defaulting to other AI gateways. The timing is about mindshare, not a new model.

4. Don't trust the dashboard

Test one real endpoint with a prompt you already use. If the cache layer isn't on, your first response might be slower than the fallback you left.

5. Test before your users do

Take one live prompt from your app and run it through Jev today. If it fails the cache test, you just saved yourself a public outage.
